name.zh: 坐椅无阻力髋外旋控制

purpose.zh: 低负荷练髋外旋的主动控制
purpose.en: Train low-load control of hip external rotation.

text.zh: 大腿和膝盖不动，脚慢慢向内摆
text.en: Keep your thigh and knee still and swing your foot slowly inward

text.zh: 坐在椅子上，脚稍离地，另一只脚踩稳
text.en: Sit with the working foot just off the floor and the other foot planted.

text.zh: 小幅度慢慢摆动，身体不转
text.en: Move through a small range slowly without turning your body.

cautions.zh: 膝或髋疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your knees or hips hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
